integrity: The Gaussian limit has a finite-state Markov functional CLT proof and an exact covariance calculation. Exhaustive finite checks support, but do not prove, the infinite limits. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The Gaussian theorem takes n to infinity with finite M fixed. The subsequent quadratic growth of its variance coefficient is not a simultaneous M,n crossover theorem. Older finite-memory channel and memory-kernel autocorrelation recurrences are acknowledged as prior results; originality concerns the closed integrated covariance and graph edge-count asymptotics. Independent priority assessment remains outstanding.
title: Exact memory amplification of edge-count fluctuations in Pólya threshold graphs
